title: G3DT User Data Schema
description: Data that cannot be automatically extracted from project files - must be provided from quote request or manual input

architect_name.description: Full name of the requesting architect (from quote request)

building_type.description: Type of building: 'Habitatge unifamiliar', 'Habitatge plurifamiliar', 'Nau industrial', 'Edifici comercial', etc.

num_floors.description: Floor configuration in Catalan notation: Pb = planta baixa, Pp = planta pis, Ps = planta soterrani

superficie_parcela_m2.description: Total parcel area in square meters (0 if not specified)

superficie_construida_m2.description: Built area in square meters (0 if not specified)

has_basement.description: Whether the building has a basement (planta soterrani)

has_retaining_walls.description: Whether the project includes retaining walls (murs de contenció)

street_address.description: Full street address including municipality name

utm_x.description: UTM X coordinate (easting) ETRS89 Huso 31 - preferably from cadastral WFS, not geocoding

utm_y.description: UTM Y coordinate (northing) ETRS89 Huso 31 - preferably from cadastral WFS, not geocoding

referencia_catastral.description: 14-char cadastral reference (e.g. '4613172CG1141S'). Used to obtain precise UTM coordinates via Cadastre WFS API

adjacent_north.description: What borders the parcel to the north: street name or 'parcel·la veïna'

adjacent_south.description: What borders the parcel to the south: street name or 'parcel·la veïna'

adjacent_east.description: What borders the parcel to the east: street name or 'parcel·la veïna'

adjacent_west.description: What borders the parcel to the west: street name or 'parcel·la veïna'

is_urban.description: Whether the site is in an urban area (sol urba)

is_sloped.description: Whether the terrain has significant slope

geological_zone.description: Geological zone classification if known from maps - null to auto-detect

num_soil_levels.description: Number of distinct soil levels identified in the study

is_anthropized.description: Whether the site shows anthropic fill or disturbance

field_work_dates.description: ISO dates of field work visits (e.g. ['2025-10-01', '2025-10-06'])

field_work_dates_text.description: Human-readable field work dates in Catalan (e.g. '1 i 6 d'octubre de 2025')

site_description.description: Description of the parcel from field visit (shape, levelling, vegetation)

access_description.description: How to access the site (e.g. 'des del Carrer existent al sud')

cota_referencia.description: Reference elevation. Can be absolute ICGC MDT (e.g. '+569.50') or relative to street level (e.g. '-4.0'). If empty, auto-filled from ICGC MDT.

foundation_depth_m.description: Foundation depth in meters. Typically 0.3m for residential (topsoil removal). Critical for Terzaghi Qa calculation

sulfate_mg_kg.description: Sulfate content in mg/kg from lab analysis (UNE 83963:2008)

icgc_unit_code.description: Override ICGC geological unit code from 1:25k map (e.g. 'ECbc', 'Tm2'). If set, bypasses WMS 1:50k auto-query

icgc_unit_description.description: Description of the ICGC geological unit (e.g. 'Bretxes calcàries amb intercalacions de lutites')

icgc_unit_epoch.description: Geological epoch of the ICGC unit (e.g. 'Eocè', 'Triàsic')

geomech_params.description: Manual override of geotechnical parameters. If set, bypasses CTE DB SE-C auto-calculation. Priority: manual > rock detection CTE > CTE correlations > Peck/Hanson
